title: Hack@BVP 8.0
description: HACK@BVP 8.0 is a flagship 24-hour hackathon organized by BVCOE, New Delhi, challenging innovators to build technology-driven solutions for real-world problems. Participants can compete across various domains for a prize pool of over ₹30 Lakhs.
requirements: Participation in an online Discord round and the offline on-campus round.

title: Code Auction
organiser: Guru Tegh Bahadur 4th Centenary Engineering College, Delhi
description: Code Auction is a team-based competitive coding event that combines programming with strategic, auction-based decision-making. Teams bid virtual currency on problems and utilize Power Cards to maximize their final scores.
requirements: A team of 2–4 members and strategic management of allocated token currency.

title: CRAFTCON 2K26
description: CRAFTCON 2K26 is a 24-hour collegiate hackathon at Desh Bhagat University where innovators solve real-world challenges through technology and creativity. Under the theme 'IMAGINE. BUILD. BEYOND.', participants transform their ideas into working prototypes.
eligibility: Teams of 2-6 members, including beginners, experienced developers, and inter-college teams.
requirements: Register via Unstop and participate in the 24-hour offline hackathon to build and demonstrate an original, working solution.

title: Stem for Impact 24hrs Hackathon
description: A 24-hour hackathon focused on developing innovative solutions to improve STEM education for school students, particularly in rural and underserved communities.
eligibility: Engineering students in teams of exactly 5 members.
requirements: Complete the confirmation form, pay registration fees, and build/demonstrate a solution within 24 hours.

title: Keep Alive ’26
organiser: Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Nagpur
description: KEEP ALIVE '26 is a national incident response championship where DevOps students investigate microservices failures using an observability stack. Participants must identify root causes and propose fixes through a multi-stage competition.
eligibility: Teams of exactly three students from the same college (UG, PG, or diploma), including up to one recent graduate (2024–2026); PhD students are ineligible.
requirements: 6–12 months of DevOps experience (Linux, Docker, Kubernetes) and at least two laptops per team for the finale.

title: D3COY
organiser: Shri Vile Parle Kelavani Mandal's Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering (DJSCE), Mumbai
description: D3COY is a 24-hour national-level innovation hackathon focused on tackling real-world challenges in security, privacy, and digital trust. Participants will build resilient products and adapt to real-time constraints in a high-intensity adversarial environment.
eligibility: All undergraduate students from any branch or background; inter-college teams are permitted.
requirements: Teams of 2-4 members must pay a ₹200 registration fee and pass Round 0 by submitting a solution PPT and member resumes.

title: FlashCode
organiser: Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Nagpur
description: Flash Code is a fast-paced coding challenge hosted by DotSlash, IIIT Nagpur, featuring three surprise mini-games. Participants compete individually for a share of a 35,000 INR prize pool.
requirements: Individual participation; requires speed, accuracy, creativity, and adaptability.

title: Ecclesia 2026
description: Ecclesia 2026 is a technology and innovation hackathon organized by Assam Down Town University that challenges students to develop practical, tech-driven solutions for real-world problems. The competition progresses through an online screening round, an offline development challenge, and a final presentation.
eligibility: Open to all undergraduate students; teams can consist of members from different colleges and academic disciplines.
requirements: Teams of 2–4 members must register via Unstop, submit a PPT for the initial screening, and maintain a GitHub repository for the offline development phase.

title: Algorithmia - The ICPC Style Coding Challenge
organiser: Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Nagpur
description: Algorithmia is a prestigious national-level ICPC-style coding competition organized by the DotSlash Coding Club of IIIT Nagpur. The event features an online preliminary round followed by an on-campus finale at IIIT Nagpur.
eligibility: Teams of 2 to 3 members with strong algorithmic and programming skills.
requirements: Registration on Codeforces and a laptop for the onsite final round.

title: The Lost Pathways (A Micromouse Event)
organiser: Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Nagpur
description: Teams compete to engineer an autonomous MicroMouse robot that navigates a 16x16 maze to find the shortest path from a corner to the center. The goal is to complete the mission in the fastest time possible.
requirements: An autonomous robot measuring no more than 16x16x10 cm, powered by onboard batteries (max 15V), without cameras or harmful mechanisms, and must pass technical inspection.

title: Kritical Hacks 2026
organiser: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW), Delhi
description: Kritical Hacks 2026 is a 24-hour open innovation hackathon where participants build technology-driven solutions in either the AI/ML or Web3 tracks. It challenges students and professionals to create practical applications featuring meaningful TinyFish integration.
eligibility: Undergraduate/postgraduate students and working professionals or independent builders.
requirements: Mandatory functional TinyFish integration and participation in all mentorship, evaluation, and presentation checkpoints.

title: GameForge '26
organiser: University School of Automation & Robotics (USAR) ,Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU), Delhi
description: GameForge ’26 is a two-day offline game jam hosted by the GameDev Guild Students Club at USAR, GGSIPU, where participants develop digital games based on a surprise theme. The event will take place on October 21–22, 2026, as part of Elysian 2026.
eligibility: College students interested in game development, participating individually or in teams of up to 4 members.
requirements: Pre-registration, adherence to a surprise theme, and submission of a playable digital game build developed during the event.

title: Debug Decrypt 3.0 — the Ultimate Algorithm Challenge
description: Debug Decrypt 3.0 is a multi-stage competitive programming competition testing knowledge of Data Structures, Algorithms, and problem-solving. The event progresses from an online qualification round to on-campus algorithmic and championship rounds.
eligibility: Students from all academic years, including first-year students.
requirements: Teams of 2 to 3 members; registration must be completed by 12 October 2026.

title: CodePuneThinkers Hackathon - Hack With Pune
description: CodePuneThinkers is a 36-hour online hackathon focused on Agentic AI, Full-Stack Product Engineering, and Open Innovation. Participants compete for a ₹30,000 prize pool, internships, and incubation opportunities.
requirements: Build solutions in the specified hackathon themes within the 36-hour timeframe.

title: Nexora'26
organiser: C. Abdul Hakeem College of Engineering and Technology (CAHCET), Veppur, Tamil Nadu
description: NEXORA ’26 is a technology-driven project-building event where participants develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges. It provides a platform for developers and innovators to showcase their technical and presentation skills by creating working prototypes.
eligibility: Students aged 17 and above; can participate individually or in teams of 2–3 members.
requirements: Registration fee (₹100 individual/₹200 team), personal laptops, chargers, and own internet connectivity.
